ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across approximately 95% of the visible surface, with localized high-intensity (white) pixel clusters providing high contrast against the dark field.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white punctate spots are scattered across both lobes; contiguous high-intensity white clusters are concentrated at the distal tips of the lobes and along the lower medial edges near the peduncle.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration pattern; left lobe features a distinct large semi-circular indentation on the interior trailing edge; the remaining edge displays low-amplitude, high-frequency jaggedness.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple unaligned white linear streaks; one prominent diagonal mark is visible on the right lobe, with several shorter vertical scratches on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant macro-scale notch/tissue deficit is visible on the upper trailing edge of the left lobe, proximal to the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense, high-relief white calcification or barnacle colonization is localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
